OH-2025-HR560.title: Honoring Emma Wagner and Saanvi Reddy as the 2026 Division I State Champions in girls doubles tennis.
OH-2025-HR560.aiSummary: The Ohio House adopted a resolution honoring Emma Wagner and Saanvi Reddy as the 2026 Division I state champions in girls doubles tennis. It formally recognizes their achievement.

OH-2025-SR455.title: Honoring the Canton Palace Theatre on its One Hundredth Anniversary.
OH-2025-SR455.aiSummary: The resolution honors the Canton Palace Theatre on its 100th anniversary and recognizes its long role in local arts and entertainment. It also notes the work of the people connected with the theater, including leaders, performers, crew, and volunteers. The Senate clerk would send a copy of the resolution to the theater.

OH-2025-HR557.title: Honoring the Niles McKinley High School marching band on its Centennial.
OH-2025-HR557.aiSummary: The Ohio House adopted a resolution honoring the Niles McKinley High School marching band on its 100th anniversary. It also sends the band an official copy of the resolution. The measure is a formal statement of praise and good wishes.

OH-2025-SB480.title: Require coroner to preserve DNA sample for future analysis
OH-2025-SB480.summary: To enact section 313.124 of the Revised Code to require a coroner to preserve and store a DNA sample for future genetic analysis when the coroner performs an autopsy and is unable to determine a cause of death.
OH-2025-SB480.summarySource: Ohio legislature, long title (via Open States)
OH-2025-SB480.policyArea: Health and Human Services, Local Government, State and Local Government
OH-2025-SB480.aiSummary: The bill would require a coroner to keep and store a DNA sample for later genetic testing when an autopsy is done and the cause of death cannot be found. It would apply to coroners in those cases.

OH-2025-HB1026.title: Increase and expand the research and development tax credit
OH-2025-HB1026.summary: To amend sections 5726.56 and 5751.51 of the Revised Code to increase and expand the research and development tax credit.
OH-2025-HB1026.summarySource: Ohio legislature, long title (via Open States)
OH-2025-HB1026.aiSummary: The bill would increase and expand Ohio’s research and development tax credit. It would change state tax law rules for this tax break for research and development costs.

OH-2025-SB477.title: Revise law regarding electric bicycles, other mobility devices
OH-2025-SB477.summary: To amend sections 4507.11, 4508.02, 4511.01, 4511.20, 4511.514, 4511.522, and 4511.54 and to enact sections 4503.184 and 4508.081 of the Revised Code to revise the law regarding electric bicycles, low-speed micromobility devices, and electric personal assistive mobility devices.
OH-2025-SB477.summarySource: Ohio legislature, long title (via Open States)
OH-2025-SB477.policyArea: Crimes, Corrections, and Law Enforcement, Highways, Roads, and Bridges, Law Enforcement
OH-2025-SB477.aiSummary: The bill would change Ohio law on electric bicycles, low-speed micromobility devices, and electric personal assistive mobility devices. It would affect people who use these devices and others on the road, under the state traffic laws tied to them.

OH-2025-HB733.title: Include maple syrup, maple product production to agriculture law
OH-2025-HB733.summary: To amend sections 1.61, 303.01, 519.01, 901.511, 929.01, 1311.55, 1729.01, and 5501.50 of the Revised Code to expressly include the production of maple syrup and maple products in the laws relating to agriculture.
